summary: Canonical ingestion protocol and reference runtime: resumable, provenance-backed, privacy-reviewed import of any data (documents, lore/fiction, writing style, speech/chat, HR records) into a pinned downstream repository. Owns the shared document-extraction/OCR cache and the restart-safe ingestion ledger used by Agent OS.
current_priorities: Analysis-adapter interface for interpretive lenses (theme, emotion, craft, character, narrative, revision, preference, research), candidate-only and cached by normalized hash.
Adoption mode: reversible migration of existing repositories into the reference layout.
Revision alignment from revision_of lineage; research saturation tracking; split-safe ML exports.
Audio/video transcription adapter behind the pending-units queue.
constraints: Protocol (INGESTER.md, spec/) is authoritative; the runtime implements it.
No organization-specific vocabulary or data in the engine; downstream repos supply ingester/vocabulary.json.
Primary-corpus processing requires corpus.primary_processing_authorized in the downstream INGESTER.yaml.
Private stores (document cache, placeholder keys, locator maps) live outside every Git working tree.

provenance.reason: Ingestion primitives (ledger, document cache) extracted from Agent OS; engine is canonical for ingestion.
